headline: Owner's new focus is the guild's P1: a rolling market compass that puts afternoon setups on standby when the morning condition flips, starting with the Graveyard coil setups.
bullets: P1 (owner 2026-11-10): backfill the live compass over 2 years, then test whether setups that open after a midday flip do worse; coil-under-the-high first. Gross first, random-standby control, every flip definition counted.
GATE2 closed: the rework lost before costs; exiting when SPY falls back to its open made trades worse (SPY recovers too often). Lineage 0 of 15.
HODSEP closed: with the look-ahead bug fixed the near-high separation disappeared.

Live trades (18 days): entering at a fresh extreme is not worse book-wide, so no blanket rule; but flow-sell shorts sold at a fresh low lose (MF2 -0.40R vs +0.28R) - a targeted idea for a 2-year test.
Since the guild started: 68 configs scored, 0 pass; every closure has a measured reason.
next: Builder backfills the compass (validated vs live); Scout plans the flip study; Observer writes the flow-sell fresh-low skip for a 2-year test.
